Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first error happened when WebSurfer searched for “gyms within 5 miles of 400 Main Street, Point Pleasant, WV 25550” and returned a result set that included clearly irrelevant locations in Mount Pleasant, South Carolina (e.g., Crunch Fitness - Mount Pleasant and Cage Fitness). These are not near the Mothman Museum in West Virginia, so the search results were geographically wrong. Because later verification was based on this flawed result set, the final answer was also wrong.
